title: Backlog item (Mandate L) — siamese-reconcile
description: One JSON object per line in .memory/T2_semantic/backlog.jsonl. Append-only: a status change is a NEW line with the same id; the latest line for an id wins. Adapted from the playbooks template (2026-07-02 port); siamese additions: severity + owner are REQUIRED on every line, optional claude_md_id links a migrated CLAUDE.md §14 item, optional tags groups related items (e.g. playbooks-port). Gate: scripts/pre_commit_backlog_check.sh validates staged lines against this schema.

severity.description: critical = blocks daily reconciliation; high = required by the SOP/rules but absent; medium = real gap, workaround exists; low = ergonomics / optional

owner.description: who holds the next action: cc (Claude Code), kanin (owner / external input), fc (Financial Controller)

claude_md_id.description: the CLAUDE.md §14 id this item was migrated from, if any

surfaced_in.description: commit sha, session id, or document where this was surfaced

closed_in.description: commit sha (or loop name) that closed it
